csv_project_name: AE Svc for Conservation Warden office building
csv_scope_of_work: A/E to provide design through construction administration services as indicated in the DFD Policy and Procedure Manual for Architects/Engineers and Consultants and the DFD AE Contract for Professional Services for the renovation project of the historically registered Conservation Warden office building (Building# 1021) at the North Shore of Devil s Lake State Park. The selected A/E will be required to assist DNR with coordination of the design renovations with the Wisconsin State Historic Preservation Office (SHPO). This project will renovate the existing office building (Building# 1021), which is located near the North Shore of Devil s Lake Station Park. The scope of work includes interior and exterior renovations and remediation of hazardous materials from the building
